Data.title: Resident Households by Planning Area of Residence and Monthly Household Income from Work
Data.footnote: Notes: Planning areas refer to areas demarcated in the Urban Redevelopment Authority’s Master Plan 2019.Household income from work includes employer CPF contributions.Data on income from work have been updated to include Additional MediSave Contributions from employers with the release of the Key Household Income Trends 2025 report in February 2026. For more information, you may refer to the Technical Note on Household Income (https://go.gov.sg/khit2025-tech-note) which explains the concepts and components of our household income coverage.
